name: WAIMD — Work Assignment. Instant Move Decision.
constitution: WAIMD transforms a travel nurse's accepted assignment into three evidence-backed housing choices. Nothing else until strangers pay for that outcome.
description: A decision engine — NOT another housing marketplace. A confirmed travel-nurse assignment in → 3 evidence-backed housing choices out. Five deterministic gates + a 100-pt score (budget 30 / commute 25 / date confidence 20 / evidence freshness 15 / preference 10) over candidates, a LISTED/CHECKED/CONFIRMED evidence model where only CONFIRMED may say 'availability confirmed'. Free Match #1 preview, $29 unlocks the full Decision, $0 if fewer than three qualify.
icp: A U.S. travel nurse who has accepted a temporary hospital assignment, starts within 30 days, and has not secured housing (PRD §1).
core_object: Housing Mission (not user, not listing, not landlord — PRD §6, §30)
stack: Next.js + TypeScript (mobile-first), Supabase free tier, Stripe Checkout, PostHog free tier
domain_note: Repurposed from the killed dot-navigator (D24, FMCSA). waimd.org must be detached from dot-navigator-app and that deploy torn down BEFORE this SKU goes live on the domain (founder-gated). Trust architecture (§19): .org must never imply nonprofit — WAIMD is a product of Voco Technologies Inc.
billing: freemium preview → $29 one-time unlock (TEST until the D5 publish gate); $0 if fewer than three qualifying options
fulfillment: founder-in-the-loop for the first 10–50 missions (PRD §18) — interventions are labeled data (manual_reason enum) that become the automation backlog
gtm_note: NOT gtm/waimd — that is the frozen FMCSA cold-email engine (D24). Meta requires the applicable Housing Special Ad Category; no circumvention of targeting restrictions (§20).
lead_source: Meta ads (Housing Special Ad Category, required)
supply_constraint: PRD §17 — $0 owned inventory; do NOT scrape sources whose terms prohibit it. Public/authorized information + founder-assisted verification only.
critical_path_llm: none — PRD §26 (deterministic engine). D22 caching-check passes at zero call sites; do not add an LLM to satisfy a checker.
success_gate: 10 qualified Housing Missions -> >=3 paid Housing Decisions
next_decision_gate: Founder approves PRD + authorizes maximum $70 Meta validation spend
author: factory (D25); PRD v0.1 verbatim from founder (D26)
